traits.fruit_type.note: Wikipedia, Cannabaceae (read 2026-10-16): fruit an achene or a drupe, and Celtis is by far the largest genus (about 100 species); Wikipedia's Celtis page calls its fruit a small drupe, so drupe leads and the achenes of Cannabis and Humulus come second.

traits.perianth.note: Wikipedia Cannabaceae (read 2026-10-16): petals lacking; reduced perianth of one whorl.

traits.hypanthium.note: Wikipedia Cannabaceae (read 2026-10-16): reduced petal-less flowers with a cup-like bracteole, no floral cup described.

traits.division_pattern.note: Wikipedia Cannabaceae (read 2026-10-16): leaves often palmately lobed or palmately compound.

traits.inflorescence.note: Wikipedia Cannabaceae (read 2026-10-16): flowers in cymes, male ones panicle-like.

traits.sexual_system.note: Wikipedia Cannabaceae (read 2026-10-16): often dioecious (Cannabis, Humulus). Celtis (~100 of ~170 spp.) polygamo-monoecious from my knowledge, hence polygamous first; medium confidence.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Wikipedia, Celtis (read 2026-10-17): simple leaves ovate with drawn-out tip. Celtis is the largest genus of Cannabaceae s.l., so it decides (genus weighting).
